text_en: But now thus says the Lord , he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine.
text_cn: 但是现今，雅各伯啊！那创造你的，以色列啊！那形成你的上主这样说：“你不要害怕！因为我救赎了你，我以你的名字召叫了你，你是我的。

text_en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you; when you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.
text_cn: 当你由水中经过时，我必与你在一起；当你渡河时，河水不得淹没你；当你在火中走过时，你不致烙伤，火焰也烧不着你。

text_en: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I give Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in exchange for you.
text_cn: 因为我是上主，你的天主；以色列的圣者，你的救主；我使埃及作你的赎价，以雇士和色巴来代替你。

text_en: Because you are precious in my sight, and honored, and I love you, I give people in return for you, nations in exchange for your life.
text_cn: 因为你在我眼中是宝贵的，是贵重的，我爱慕你；所以我拿别人交换了你，拿别的民族交换了你的性命。

text_en: Do not fear, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east, and from the west I will gather you;
text_cn: 不要害怕！因为我同你在一起，我要从东方领回你的子女，从西方将你召集在一起；

text_en: I will say to the north, “Give them up, ” and to the south, “Do not withhold; bring my sons from far away and my daughters from the end of the earth—
text_cn: 我要向北方说：“交出来！”向南方说：“不要拦阻他们，要将我的儿子们从远方带来，要将我的女儿们由地极领回，

text_en: everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made. ”
text_cn: 就是凡归于我名下，并为了我的光荣而创造、形成和造化的人。”

text_en: Bring forth the people who are blind, yet have eyes, who are deaf, yet have ears!
text_cn: 领那有眼而瞎，有耳而聋的民族出来吧！

text_en: Let all the nations gather together, and let the peoples assemble. Who among them declared this, and foretold to us the former things? Let them bring their witnesses to justify them, and let them hear and say, “It is true. ”
text_cn: 让列国聚在一起，万民集合起来！他们中谁能预言这事呢？谁能预先报告给我们过去的事呢？让他们找出证人来，为证实自己有理，好让听众能说：“对啊！”

text_en: You are my witnesses, says the Lord , and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor shall there be any after me.
text_cn: 你们就是我的证人──上主的断语──你们是我拣选的仆人，为叫你们认识和信仰我，并明白我就是“那位”；在我以前，没有受造的神；在我以后，也决不会有。

text_en: I, I am the Lord , and besides me there is no savior.
text_cn: 我，只有我是上主，我以外没有救主；

text_en: I declared and saved and proclaimed, when there was no strange god among you; and you are my witnesses, says the Lord .
text_cn: 是我预言了，是我施行了拯救，是我宣布过的；你们中没有别的神。你们是我的证人──上主的断语──我是天主，

text_en: I am God, and also henceforth I am He; there is no one who can deliver from my hand; I work and who can hinder it?
text_cn: 且由永远就是；没有人能从我手中救出谁来；我要做的，谁能扭转？

text_en: Thus says the Lord , your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I will send to Babylon and break down all the bars, and the shouting of the Chaldeans will be turned to lamentation.
text_cn: 上主，你们的救主，以色列的圣者这样说：“为了你们，我派了人到巴比伦去，我要打断一切门闩，将加色丁人的狂欢变为悲哀。

text_en: I am the Lord , your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.
text_cn: 我是上主，你们的圣者，以色列的造主，你们的君王。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord , who makes a way in the sea, a path in the mighty waters,
text_cn: 上主这样说：──他曾在海中开了一条路，在怒潮中辟了一条道；

text_en: who brings out chariot and horse, army and warrior; they lie down, they cannot rise, they are extinguished, quenched like a wick:
text_cn: 曾使车、马、军队和将领一同前来，使他们沉没，再未浮起，他们遂被消灭，像灯心一样被熄灭──

text_en: Do not remember the former things, or consider the things of old.
text_cn: “你们不必追念古代的事，也不必回忆过去的事！

text_en: I am about to do a new thing; now it springs forth, do you not perceive it? I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.
text_cn: 看哪！我要行一件新事，如今即要发生，你们不知道吗？看哪！我要在荒野中开辟道路，在沙漠里开掘河流。

text_en: The wild animals will honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; for I give water in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to my chosen people,
text_cn: 田野间的走兽、豺狼和鸵鸟都要赞美我，因为我在旷野中使水涌出，在沙漠里使河流成渠，为赐给我拣选的百姓喝：

text_en: the people whom I formed for myself so that they might declare my praise.
text_cn: 就是我为自己所造化的人民，好叫他们讲述我的荣耀。”

text_en: Yet you did not call upon me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of me, O Israel!
text_cn: “但是，雅各伯啊！你并没有呼号我；以色列啊！你竟厌烦了我。

text_en: You have not brought me your sheep for burnt offerings, or honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, or wearied you with frankincense.
text_cn: 你没有献给我全燔祭羔羊，也没有用你的牺牲光荣我；我从没有因了素祭而劳累你，也没有因了馨香祭而烦扰你。

text_en: You have not bought me sweet cane with money, or satisfied me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins; you have wearied me with your iniquities.
text_cn: 你不但没有花钱给我买香菖蒲，也没有以你牺牲的肥脂供养我，反而用你的罪恶劳累了我，以你的愆（qiān）尤烦扰了我。

text_en: I, I am He who blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and I will not remember your sins.
text_cn: 是我，是我自己，为了我自己的缘故，免除了你的过犯，不再怀念你的罪恶。

text_en: Accuse me, let us go to trial; set forth your case, so that you may be proved right.
text_cn: 请你提醒我，让我们一起来辩论：你先说吧！好表示你无罪。

text_en: Your first ancestor sinned, and your interpreters transgressed against me.
text_cn: 你的祖先犯了罪，你的中保背叛了我！

text_en: Therefore I profaned the princes of the sanctuary, I delivered Jacob to utter destruction, and Israel to reviling.
text_cn: 为此，我使你的圣君受了亵渎，使雅各伯遭受了毁灭，使以色列遭到了耻辱。”
